factors.hypothesis: An opening gap confirmed by the intraday move is information arrival rather than a temporary ETF premium or discount and should continue in the combined direction.
factors.name: ORC_GAP_CONFIRMATION_20

factors.hypothesis: The intraday direction after a volatility-scaled opening dislocation reveals which side absorbed the gap and is expected to persist.
factors.name: ORC_GAP_ABSORPTION_20

factors.hypothesis: Returns concentrated at the open but not sustained intraday are more consistent with a temporary ETF premium or discount and should fade.
factors.name: ORC_OVERNIGHT_DOMINANCE_20

factors.hypothesis: An edge-of-range close backed by unusual volume proxies late-session pressure that carries into the next decision period.
factors.name: ORC_CLOSE_PRESSURE_VOLUME_20

factors.hypothesis: A stable positive intraday drift relative to the volatility of its own recent open-to-close moves reflects persistent session-level buying pressure.
factors.name: ORC_INTRADAY_RANGE_RETURN_10

protocol.discovery_scope: purged rolling train and validation folds only
protocol.locked_holdout_policy: Do not inspect or tune on the final chronological holdout until families, candidates, model, and strategy parameters are frozen; evaluate that holdout once.
protocol.multiplicity_control: Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery rate at q=0.10 within the frozen catalog
protocol.primary_metric: mean validation daily rank IC in the declared direction
required_robustness_checks: same sign in a majority of validation folds
